what: A sliding-tile puzzle runs continuously on a grid board (default 11 columns × 3 rows) where shape tiles slide into the empty cell — one step .5s power2.inOut, a neighbor of the empty cell slides in either one cell horizontally or two cells vertically (vertical is 5 times as frequent), with a .2s rest. After advancing three steps it returns along the same path and rests .8s. Each step changes two shapes to other shapes (ratio square 8 · circle 2 · others 1), and tiles within 100px of the cursor shrink down to .72× by distance (.4s power3.out). Each step fires an fx:tile-step event (the original changes the title word every three steps)

options.dur · hold · rest: Step length · pause between steps · pause after a full loop (sec), default .5·.2·.8
options.bias: Weight pushed vertically (relative to horizontal 1), default 5
options.morph: Number of tiles that change shape per step, default 2 — 0 means no change
options.shrink · reach: Size right above the cursor and reach distance (px), default .72·100 — shrink: 1 turns it off
